messages:
maria (partnerships): Quick heads-up — proposing an SI Fast-Track enablement pilot that bundles: 1) 2-week hands-on lab w/ HW partner nodes, 2) a micro-cert for SI engineers, 3) a simplified marketplace listing template, and 4) a joint announcement window. Want to align on timeline and owners.
aj (solutions): +1. Important we lock the lab access model early. Who owns creds and proctoring?
rick (training): I can own the micro-cert content and exam. Prefer two tracks: "Integrator" (deploy + infra) and "Feature" (prompting, evals). Each is ~2 modules + practical.
sam (devex): Lab UX matters — need ephemeral creds + a self-service onboarding script. Proposing a short starter script:
```
# bootstrap lab access
./grant_lab_access --si acme-int --duration 14d
```
If ops can support an API for provisioning, we can avoid manual tickets.
dena (ops): We can expose a provisioning API but need an allowlist and billing tag. Also must confirm HW partner SLA for preemptible nodes during the pilot window.
chris (eng): From runtime side, suggest we provide a pre-baked model bundle (quantized variant + benchmark config) so SIs can repro performance. Also adding a small perf-check harness will save support time.
lia (product): For marketplace listing, we should create a single canonical artifact (YAML) that partners can reuse. Also want the joint announcement gated on: pilot success metrics (install + demo + two reference sessions). Timeline?
maria (partnerships): Thinking timeline: 2 weeks content build + 2 weeks pilot = 4 weeks. Proposed kickoff next Mon (1781240400) and announcement tentatively 3 weeks after pilot end. Is that realistic?
aj (solutions): Tight but doable if we compress content. We can run a 10 SI cohort concurrently during pilot. Need partner commits.
rick (training): I’ll draft module outlines this week. Need a small rubric for the practical exercise — pass/fail + scoring for badge.
sam (devex): I can build the onboarding script and short guided notebook. Recommend we reuse the existing eval harness from dev-tools but strip org-specific telemetry.
dena (ops): Agree to API work but timeline depends on QA. If we cut scope (manual onboarding for first cohort) we can hit kickoff.
chris (eng): I’ll assemble the model bundle and perf harness. Can we get access to a sample SI workload? A small prompt set + seq lengths to tune batching.
maria (partnerships): @chris I’ll ping the SI leads for sample workloads. @lia can you draft the marketplace YAML template?
lia (product): On it. Will include fields: short description, tested models, supported deployment modes (hosted/dedicated/private), contact, and a quickstart link.
aj (solutions): Also add an explicit fallback policy section (what happens if capacity spikes) — SIs will want to know reliability guarantees.
rick (training): Question: proctoring for the practical — do we accept video proctoring or live demo? Ops might prefer automated checks.
dena (ops): Automated checks + a short 10-min recorded demo should be enough for pilot. Live proctoring is heavy.
maria (partnerships): Decisions captured: 1) Rick = cert content, 2) Sam = onboarding + notebook, 3) Chris = model bundle & harness, 4) Dena = provisioning API (opt) but manual fallback, 5) Lia = marketplace YAML, 6) Aj = SI recruitment. Kickoff target next Mon.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: teams/partnerships/si-fasttrack-provisioner -> staging at 2026-04-06T09:00Z
aj (solutions): One ask — can we get a short PR/announcement blurb template so marketing can prep? I can draft if someone gives bullets.
maria (partnerships): I’ll send bullets by EOD: pilot goals, expected outcomes, quote from HW partner, and embargo window.
chris (eng): Tiny note — include a perf SLO example in the docs (e.g., p95 < 250ms for 512 tokens on dedicated pool) so SIs understand expectations.
rick (training): For the micro-cert badge, recommended metadata: badge id, version, competency tags (deployment, latency tuning, quantization), and expiry (1 year).
sam (devex): Final UX question: should SIs get a sandbox account with billing disabled? Ops — is that doable?
dena (ops): Yes, sandbox accounts with billing disabled and usage caps are standard. We need a billing contact and a cost center tag.
maria (partnerships): Great. Action items: Rick draft modules (due Thu), Sam onboarding script + notebook (due Thu), Chris model bundle + harness (due Fri), Lia marketplace YAML draft (due Thu), Dena provisional API plan or manual fallback doc (due Thu), Aj SI recruitment list (due Wed). Will run a 30m kickoff Mon to sync.
aj (solutions): Sounds good. Thanks all. :rocket:
